timing_scope: Each process constructs its own in-memory input. Construction time and Rust allocator calls are separate. Eleven black-box preflight calls follow. Clock/counter overhead is included without subtraction. First sample is after construction, not a cold-cache guarantee. A fixed4096-call batch also records CPU with loop/counter overhead; zero deltas are unresolved, not zero cost. A fixed empty-loop reference is recorded raw and never subtracted. Per-trial output fsync is outside parser timing but inside process wall/CPU/RSS. RSS includes construction.
